title: Pappardelle in Tuscan Mushroom Sauce
subtitle: a lighter mushroom sauce
description: Pappardelle in a Tuscan-style sauce of fresh and dried porcini mushrooms, thyme and garlic, partly blended for a rich sauce that is relatively light.

steps.text: Soak the dried porcini in 2/3 cup boiling water for 30 minutes. Strain and keep the liquid.
Heat the olive oil in a deep frying pan and fry the sliced garlic until fragrant. Add the fresh and dried mushrooms, thyme leaves, salt and pepper and saute for 2-3 minutes.
Add the soaking liquid, reduce the heat, cover and cook for 10-15 minutes until the mushrooms are completely soft.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente.
Transfer half of the sauce to a food processor, add 1/2 cup of the pasta cooking water and blend to a slightly coarse texture.
Return the blended sauce to the pan and mix with the rest of the sauce. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Add the cooked pasta and the parmesan, stir for a minute and serve.
